title: Business Gold Rewards Card: How to Access Airport Lounges Worldwide
summary: Explains Business Gold Rewards Card lounge access: 9 complimentary lounge visits per account year across 3 participating lounge networks. Covers activation in the account dashboard, what to show at the lounge door (card + boarding pass, possibly government ID), how visit counts update, and troubleshooting if the card isn’t recognized.
faqs: How many complimentary lounge visits per year does my Business Gold Rewards Card include?

What happens if I use all 9 complimentary lounge visits?
What should I do if my card isn’t recognized at the lounge?
